full_judgment: 84. The grant of legislative power in the proviso to Article 117 (2) is Plenary in nature. Anyone denying a particular power, or alleging a limitation on a, must show that the power does not exist or the Constitution expressly or by necessary implications limits the power. There can be no presumption by a Court of a limited grant of legislative power because to limit the grant of legislative power is a constituent and not a judicial function."
